subject: multiple outputs from single output environment

messages.author: 1d0f46fc6d376888
messages.subject: multiple outputs from single output environment
parts:
Hi, 

I'm not sure if this is available, but it'd be really nice to have. What I'm talking about is in server.R, I have a data.gen() function in the reactive environment that generates the data according to input. However, if I wish to process this data different ways, say a list of statistics (text output) and a graph (plot output), I'd have to call data.gen() twice, each time in a separate environment. This is quite inefficient when the data generating process is relatively long. So I'm wondering if there is anything that would allow me to call the data.gen() function once but produce two different outputs?

Thanks!
Fu

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: multiple outputs from single output environment
parts:
See the three sections in the tutorial under "Understanding Reactivity" - they'll explain how to reduce redundant computation. This is the first section:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#reactivity-overview

The next section, "Execution scheduling", gives an example of what you're looking for.

-Winston
